items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1969-03-24
items.q: he played a couple of times in there, because I had hired him.

ctx.x: Now, you were sick yourself around about this time, weren't you?

Yeah, I was. Yeah, I was sick. But not, you know, like I am now, you know? I was getting around, but it was pretty tough. But anyway... I'll give Larry credit... For starting off this jazz revival. Not, uh, not starting it off, but keeping it going. Because he took in, uh, I don't know what this place, what the hall was before he... Put the bands in there. But they tell me that punch... With the voice band to start working in there. Mm-hmm. And then he start rounding up the other old musicians and... And giving…
